articles.title_en: Moscow court hands blogger Michael Naki a second prison sentence in absentia, bringing his combined term to 14 years
articles.lead_en: Moscow’s Basmanny District Court sentenced blogger Michael Naki in absentia to five years in a penal colony for publicly calling for activities aimed at undermining Russia’s security (Article 280.4, Part 2, Paragraph “c” of the Criminal Code).
